notes.title: DevBlog 15/04 – The New Android Model
notes.content:
Greetings, gladiators!
Welcome to our DevBlog series, where we’ll regularly share behind-the-scenes updates, upcoming features, visual upgrades, and more. 
These entries are designed to keep you — our players and testers — in sync with our development journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504486/33cb9cb0272aa10e45af577b5a8c4da8d756d081.jpg[/img]

[b]The Android Has Evolved[/b]
We’ve completed a major update to the core android model. It is now:
[list]
[*] Stronger — with a reinforced frame and improved animations
[*] More complete — visually and technically
[*] More impactful — both in presence and gameplay
[/list]
This is more than a cosmetic update — it’s the foundation for a deeper, more immersive player experience.

[b]Customization System in Development[/b]
We are actively working on a player customization system that will allow you to personalize your android. From visual elements to functional modules, you’ll be able to shape your android to match your unique style and strategy.
Stay tuned — more details will be revealed soon.

[b]Special Skin for Top Playtesters[/b]
We’re also preparing a limited-edition reward skin that will be granted only to the top-performing players in the upcoming playtest.
Your skill, strategy, and contribution to testing will determine who earns it.

Thanks for being a part of this journey.
We’ll see you in the next DevBlog — and on the battlefield.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2259240/DESPA/ style=button][b]Wishlist now and join the playtest![/b][/url]

notes.title: DESPA ARMOURY: CHOOSE YOUR WEAPON!
notes.content:
[i]There are no heroes in this world. There are only survivors. And to survive, you need a weapon that won't let you down. In DESPA, every gun is an instrument of your domination. Let's take a closer look at the available arsenal!
[/i]

[b]ASSAULT RIFLE — THE HAVOC[/b]
It's not just a rifle — it's your rage. Reliable, deadly, perfectly balanced. Mid-range is its territory. Acquire the target, destroy the target.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504486/4556d569276533d79009f9f13bfb128c94205c54.gif[/img]

[b]Shotgun — BREAKPOINT[/b]
You don't need a long gunfight. Get close, exhale, and blow the enemy to pieces. [b]BREAKPOINT[/b] is pure, uncompromising aggression.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504486/ed090c4618a5c060828889cd8c8dac5328854c97.gif[/img]

[b]KATANA — REAPER[/b]
When you're out of ammo, and the enemy is too close, the [b]REAPER[/b] is your only option. Fast, sharp, deadly effective. One move, and the fight is over.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504486/d727c23fcbda60fc67bcbae76131f9c0a2800e93.gif[/img]

[b]SNIPER RIFLE — ECLIPSE[/b]
You are death from the shadows. One shot, one kill. [b]ECLIPSE[/b] doesn't forgive misses, but if you're accurate enough, you'll be the nightmare of the arena.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504486/1bef9d5db632f9d43632c24be715d64a062aa0c3.gif[/img]

[b]Rocket Launcher — QUAKE[/b]
If you want to hit, predict your enemies' movements. If you want to survive, clear the field. Mid-range is the perfect zone for [b]QUAKE[/b] to turn a crowd into a pile of scrap metal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504486/7d6360354f6f7fd742f0099cf61f41af39e527ba.gif[/img]


Want to try each weapon at an upcoming playtest and pick what you like?
Join the Discord and be ready!
